correctness.rationale: For unordered distinct triples, n<=2 has no queries, n=3 has one nonconstant classifier query. At n>=3 the all-zero vector and n singleton-one vectors collapse to one identically zero concept; at most 2^n-n<2^n distinct functions excludes a mistake tree of depth n. Four-bit queries 123,124,134 realize all eight three-bit response words using mixed assignments. Inductively for each leaf choose existing coordinates of values 0 and 1; query their triple with coordinate n+1, whose majority is exactly the new bit, leaving old labels untouched and all witnesses mixed. Depth increments once per coordinate, proving Ldim=n-1 for n>=4. Reimplemented exact truth-table minimax n<=7 and direct mixed-witness induction; both match. Important: upper bound uses distinct functions, not assignments.
residual_risks: Coordinates on each triple are distinct and unordered; realizable online dimension only, not noise/learning-time or VC polynomial.
